notes.title: Ogre Chambers 2 is announced!!
notes.content:
Announcing MY NEXT GAME !!!


So excited to make a sequel to Ogre Chambers DX! It is my first game that got somewhat popular and holds a special place in my heart!



Ogre Chambers 2222 is a ROGUELIKE, where you FIND and FUSE ABILITIES, while raiding TRANSFORMING space chambers 💥 Traverse randomized planets - Murder their populations - Get stronger - Take down Ogre Overlords! 💀 But remember, DO NOT anger the ogres beyond your guns' capabilities!


❤️❤️❤️ WISHLIST NOW! ❤️❤️❤️

notes.title: v1.0.3 - Spaceship Unlock Change! + NEW GAME!
notes.content:
Enjoyers of Ogre Chambers DX I got news for you!!

Game's now better than ever!

 Spaceships are unlocked with combined score of all spaceships! 😎
 Easier Star Target scores 😱
 Smoother gameplay 🧴
 Almost 25% smaller file size! Ear destroying main menu music is gone 🤯


MORE GOOD NEWS!
I have released a new game on Steam!!

Lake of Creatures is a difficult action FISHING ROGUELIKE, where you slaughter mutated creatures with weapons that shoot lasers and explosions!!! 💥
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808320/Lake_of_Creatures/

Please check out my new game! 💖 It has some similarities and maybe even a reference to Ogre Chambers 😉

notes.title: Easier Spaceship Unlocks!! - v1.0.2
notes.content:
I've noticed the requirements for unlocking new spaceships have been too high so I decided to make unlocking them a little easier!

Update features:

 Lower spaceship unlock requirements on all spaceships.
 Adjusted star target requirements.
 Spaceship doesn't get stuck to the ceiling anymore when hugging the ceiling while shooting downwards.


Side note:
Also! If you've been enjoying Ogre Chambers DX, you will surely like my next game, a fishing roguelike releasing soon on 25th of May! Please check it out :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808320/Lake_of_Creatures/

notes.title: Polish Localization & Fixes! - v1.0.1
notes.content:
Small update featuring:


Polish localization
Players who have reached star target score now have their star shown in global leaderboards.
Hotkeys to enable/disable fullscreen. (F4 & F11)
Fixes in German localization
Fixed crash when pressing ESC when viewing leaderboards in game over screen.


Thanks for checking the game out <3
Please consider dropping a review :)
